qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | postdoctoral fellow (research associate-i): i. Doctorate in Mechanical Engineering / Aerospace Engineering/ Physics from a recognized institute. ii. Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering / Aerospace Engineering / Chemical Engineering/ Physics from a recognized institute and with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 on a 10.0 point scale (or 65% marks). iii. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering / Aerospace Engineering / Chemical Engineering/ Physics from a recognized institute and with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 on a 10.0 point scale (or 65% marks).

salary_details.details: The notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits.

how_to_apply: Check eligibility requirements from the official notification.
Fill out the Google form with all required personal and educational details.
Submit the Google form on or before 25 October 2026.
important_instructions: The candidate will be appointed initially for one year and appointment will be renewed every year based on the performance. The duration of the appointment is 3 years or the project completion date, whichever is earlier. Eligible applicants must fill out the specified online Google form before the closing date. Candidates should have an extensive knowledge of Fluid Mechanics fundamentals. A research background in flapping wing aerodynamics, insect flight, surface wettability, micro and nanofabrication, numerical and experimental techniques in fluid mechanics will be preferable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: IIT Ropar has invited applications for the Postdoctoral Fellow (Research Associate-I) position under the ANRF funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to fill out the online application form is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for IIT Ropar Postdoctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive emoluments of Rs. 58000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Doctorate in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Physics, along with appropriate Bachelor's and Master's degrees with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 65% marks.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants must fill out the online Google form provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration is 3 years or the project completion date, whichever is earlier, with initial appointment for one year subject to renewal based on performance.
